resolved_findings.issue: Initial exact size and final identity checks did not bound the EOF hashing loop during concurrent growth.
resolved_findings.resolution: read_original now consumes at most expected_bytes + 1, requires exact byte_count, and retains before/opened/after_open/after identity checks.

reviewed_controls: Actual unchanged inputs.prepare source compiled and executed in a private module; only its private latent filesystem predicates/read function gain the exact five-file capability.
Original input containers, payload SHA256 values, sidecars, run contract and source/config identities remain required.
All four original positional guide stages, BF16 bit expansion, child coordinate order and final geometry coordinates remain checked by original prepare and require_prepared.
Checkpoint access remains the original bounded header-only check; no checkpoint tensor payload or model is loaded.
Canonical exact paths, complete ancestor chains, file type, single links, reparse rejection, current Windows owner SID and foreign ACL mutation checks remain required.
Guest synthetic root UID/GID mapping is accepted only on the diagnosed C: DrvFS mount, under genuine UID/GID 1000, with snapshot identities, exact fixed input hashes and bounded reads.
Guest audit hook rejects filesystem mutations except exclusive worker result output, network/subprocess entry and forbidden model/GPU imports.

Negative checks exercise actual private reader traversal/foreign paths, descriptor aliases, altered hashes, bound failures, ownership mismatch, read-only writer and untouched historical UID rejection.
required_runtime_followup: Fresh unchanged Windows attestation verification immediately before and after each actual acceptance run.
Root actual CPU acceptance followed by a separate reviewer-owned independent actual CPU rerun of the same frozen source and manifest.
Only successful actual prepared metadata, passing security controls, released array objects and clean owned containment can establish runtime acceptance.
